titleZh: Port Coquitlam 廚房裝修費用 2026：真實價格從 $20,000 起
contentEn:
A mid-range kitchen renovation in Port Coquitlam costs $40,000-$80,000 in 2026, based on actual project contracts from the Lower Mainland Metro Vancouver market. This guide covers every price tier, neighbourhood cost factors, permit requirements, and timelines.

Port Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation Cost Tiers (2026)

All prices include labour, materials, permit fees, and GST.

ScopeWhat's Included2026 Cost
Cosmetic refreshCabinet refacing or new doors, hardware, paint, new faucet, lighting$20,000 - $35,000
Mid-range renovationNew cabinet boxes + doors, quartz countertop, updated sink/faucet, new light fixtures, appliance allowance, flooring$40,000 - $80,000
PremiumCustom cabinets, natural stone countertop, layout change, high-end appliances, structural work$80,000 - $150,000
Luxury designerFull custom millwork, integrated Sub-Zero/Wolf/Miele appliances, architectural detailing$150,000+

What Drives Port Coquitlam Kitchen Costs Up

1. Layout changes with plumbing work. Moving a sink or adding a prep-sink island requires re-routing drain and supply lines. In Port Coquitlam's older split-level homes (1970s-1980s), original plumbing through cast-iron stacks is difficult to extend. Each drain relocation adds $2,000-$6,000.

2. Asbestos in popcorn ceilings or old floor tiles. Many Port Coquitlam homes built before 1990 contain asbestos in textured ceiling finishes or vinyl tiles under linoleum. Asbestos testing: $300-$600. Full abatement: $2,000-$15,000 depending on area.

3. Strata restrictions in townhouse complexes. About 40% of Port Coquitlam's residential stock is strata-titled. Most townhouse complexes require strata approval before plumbing or electrical work. Strata approval adds 2-6 weeks to the timeline and may require a deposit.

Port Coquitlam Neighbourhood Cost Differences

Citadel and Glen Ridge have larger detached homes with mid-sized kitchens from the 1980s-1990s. The main cost driver is structural: removing a pony wall to open the kitchen to the dining room requires an engineer and a beam, adding $8,000-$25,000.

Oxford Heights and Heritage Mountain are newer (1990s-2000s) with open-concept layouts. Kitchens already function well - budgets are driven by finish quality and appliance upgrades rather than structural changes. Most full renovations here cost $50,000-$100,000.

Permits Required in Port Coquitlam

A City of Port Coquitlam building permit is required when the renovation moves plumbing fixtures, adds electrical circuits, or alters a load-bearing wall. Kitchen renovation permit: $1,200-$2,500. Electrical permit: $200-$400. Plumbing permit: $150-$300 per fixture affected. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard contract.

How Long Does a Port Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation Take?

Cosmetic refresh: 2-4 weeks. Mid-range full renovation: 6-10 weeks. Premium kitchen with layout changes and custom cabinetry: 10-16 weeks. All timelines include demolition, rough-in, cabinet installation, countertop templating and installation, and final connections.

  • City of Port Coquitlam building permit and inspection coordination
  • Asbestos testing arrangement (homes built before 1990)
  • Plumbing rough-in and connections to BC Plumbing Code
  • Electrical updates to BC Electrical Code standards
  • Waterproofing at all wet areas
  • $5 million commercial general liability insurance
  • WorkSafeBC registration for all on-site tradespeople
  • 3-year workmanship warranty
  • Pressure test certificates and city inspection sign-off

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Port Coquitlam in 2026?

A mid-range Port Coquitlam kitchen renovation in 2026 typically costs $40,000-$80,000. A cosmetic refresh starts around $20,000. A premium custom kitchen with layout changes reaches $100,000-$200,000+. All prices include materials, labour, permits, and GST.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Port Coquitlam?

Yes, in most cases. Any renovation that moves plumbing fixtures, adds electrical circuits, or alters a load-bearing wall requires a City of Port Coquitlam building permit. Reno Stars confirms permit requirements during the scoping visit and handles all applications on your behalf.

Yes. Every project starts with a free in-home consultation - we measure the space, photograph existing conditions, and provide a written estimate within 3-5 business days. No obligation.

2026 年 Port Coquitlam 中端廚房裝修費用介乎 4 萬至 8 萬加元，數據來自低陸地區真實項目合約。本指南涵蓋各費用層級、社區費用因素、許可要求及工期估算。

Port Coquitlam 廚房裝修費用層級 (2026)

以下價格均包含人工、材料、許可費用及 GST。

範圍包含項目2026 年費用
整容式翻新櫃門更換或貼面，五金、牆面油漆，新水龍頭、照明$20,000 - $35,000
中端改造新櫃體+門板，石英石檯面、更新洗手盆及水龍頭，新照明燈具、電器預算、地面更新$40,000 - $80,000
高端定制櫃櫥、天然石材檯面、佈局調整、高端電器，可能涉及結構工程$80,000 - $150,000
豪華設計師級全定制木作、內嵌 Sub-Zero/Wolf/Miele 電器、建築細節$150,000+

什麼因素推高 Port Coquitlam 廚房費用？

1. 涉及水管改動的佈局調整。移動洗手盆或增設中島準備水槽需要重新佈局排水管和供水管。1970-80 年代住宅原有水管往往穿越鑄鐵主管，延伸改造難度大。每次排水改動增加 $2,000-$6,000。

2. 吊頂或舊地板中的石棉。1990 年前建造的 Port Coquitlam 住宅吊頂及油氈下地磚通常含石棉。石棉檢測：$300-$600；全面處理：$2,000-$15,000，視受影響面積而定。

3. 聯排別墅 strata 限制。Port Coquitlam 約 40% 住宅為聯排或公寓。水電或外觀工程前需 strata 批准，會使時間表增加 2-6 週。

Port Coquitlam 各地區費用差異

Citadel 和 Glen Ridge 為成熟社區，多大型獨立屋。廚房為 1980-90 年代建造。主要成本驅動為結構性：拆除廚房與餐廳之間的矮牆需工程師及鋼樑，增加 $8,000-$25,000。

Oxford Heights 和 Heritage Mountain 較新（1990-2000 年代），佈局開敞。廚房本身功能已較好，預算主要取決於飾面質量而非結構改動，多數全面改造費用 $50,000-$100,000。

Port Coquitlam 所需許可

移動水管裝置、增加電路或改動承重牆的改造，需申請高貴林港市政府建築許可。廚房裝修許可：$1,200-$2,500。電工許可：$200-$400。水管許可：$150-$300/每受影響裝置。聚星装修代為處理所有許可申請。

Port Coquitlam 廚房裝修工期

整容式翻新：2-4 週。中端全面改造：6-10 週。含佈局調整和定制櫃櫥的高端廚房：10-16 週。工期包括拆除、水電佈線、櫃體安裝、檯面模板和安裝及水電最終連接。

聚星装修每個廚房項目包含

  • 書面施工範圍及固定價格合約
  • 高貴林港市建築許可申請及檢驗協調
  • 1990 年前住宅的石棉檢測安排
  • 水管按 BC 水暖規範佈線及連接
  • 按 BC 電氣規範更新電氣線路
  • 所有濕區防水處理
  • $500 萬商業綜合責任險
  • 所有工地人員的 WorkSafeBC 登記
  • 3 年施工質量保固
  • 壓力測試證書及市政府驗收文件

常見問題

2026 年 Port Coquitlam 廚房裝修多少錢？

2026 年 Port Coquitlam 中端廚房裝修通常為 $40,000-$80,000。整容式翻新起價約 $20,000。含佈局調整的定制高端廚房可達 $100,000-$200,000+。所有價格均包含材料、人工、許可費用及 GST。

Port Coquitlam 廚房裝修需要許可嗎？

多數情況需要，凡涉及移動水管裝置、增加電路或改動承重牆的改造，均需申請高貴林港市政府建築許可。聚星装修在勘察時確認許可要求，並代表您處理所有申請。

聚星装修在 Port Coquitlam 提供免費估價嗎？

是的。每個項目均以免費上門勘察開始——測量空間、拍攝現況，並在 3-5 個工作日內提供書面估價。完全沒有義務。
